description: Report a sale or sign-up from someone who came through a tracked link. click_id is the tk value on the landing page's URL; value_cents is what it was worth; external_id (an order id) stops a retry counting twice.

click_id.description: The `tk` value on the landing page URL.

external_id.description: Optional. Your id for it. The same id twice counts once and returns the first with 200.

value_cents.description: Optional. What it was worth, in US cents.
